question: Who among the following is a famous personality of the dance form Mohiniyattam?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sunanda Nair**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sunanda Nair** is a renowned dancer known for her expertise in the classical dance form **Mohiniyattam**.
 
• Mohiniyattam is one of the eight classical dance forms of India and originates from the state of **Kerala**.
 
• It is characterized by graceful, swaying body movements and subtle facial expressions, often performed by women.
 
• Sunanda Nair has been a disciple of the legendary dancer **Dr. Kanak Rele**, who is a prominent figure in the Mohiniyattam dance form.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sitara Devi** is known for her contributions to the dance form **Kathak**.
 
• **Damayanti Joshi** is also associated with **Kathak**.
 
• **Pandit Birju Maharaj** is a legendary figure in the field of **Kathak**.
 
• Mohiniyattam is distinct from these other classical dance forms and has its own unique style and tradition.
